terms.name: Trade Identifier
terms.definition: The system-of-record identifier assigned to a trade at execution.

terms.name: Parent Trade Identifier
terms.definition: The identifier of the originating trade from which this trade was derived (e.g. allocation, novation).

terms.name: Trade Reference
terms.definition: A free-form or external reference associated with the trade.

terms.name: Trade Status
terms.definition: The current processing or lifecycle state of the trade.

terms.name: Trade Version Number
terms.definition: The sequential version of the trade record, incremented on amendment.

terms.name: Trade Event Type
terms.definition: The lifecycle event that produced this record \u2014 new, amend, cancel, novation.

terms.name: Current Record Indicator
terms.definition: Flag identifying the current/latest version of a trade among its versions.

terms.name: Notional Amount
terms.definition: The nominal or face value of a derivative used to calculate contractual payments; not itself exchanged.

terms.name: Coupon Rate
terms.definition: The stated annual interest rate paid on a fixed-income security.

terms.name: Yield
terms.definition: The effective rate of return on a fixed-income security given its price.

terms.name: Accrued Interest
terms.definition: Interest earned on a fixed-income position since the last coupon payment date but not yet paid.

terms.name: Principal Amount
terms.definition: The principal cash amount of a fixed-income trade.

terms.name: Trade Price
terms.definition: The execution price of the trade, expressed per the instrument's convention.

terms.name: Trade Quantity
terms.definition: The traded quantity, volume, or number of contracts.

terms.name: Commodity Option Premium
terms.definition: The premium paid or received on a commodity option.

terms.name: Instrument Identifier
terms.definition: A standard market identifier for the traded security (CUSIP, ISIN, ticker).

terms.name: Instrument Type
terms.definition: The classification of the instrument's structural form.

terms.name: Option Exercise Type
terms.definition: Whether the option is a put or a call.

terms.name: Product Type
terms.definition: The product classification carried on the trade as sourced from the SOR (e.g. TREAS, CommoditySwap).

terms.name: Product Sub-Type
terms.definition: The finer product classification beneath product type (e.g. TBOND, EFP).

terms.name: Product Family
terms.definition: The top-level product grouping (e.g. Commodity, Fixed Income).

terms.name: Net Present Value
terms.definition: The present value of a trade's expected future cash flows in USD.

terms.name: Profit and Loss Explained
terms.definition: The decomposition of P&L change attributed to identifiable market and trade factors.

terms.name: Realised Profit and Loss
terms.definition: P&L locked in from closed or settled positions.

terms.name: Unrealised Profit and Loss
terms.definition: Mark-to-market P&L on open positions not yet settled.

terms.name: Closing Price
terms.definition: The official closing or mark price used for valuation.

terms.name: Option Delta
terms.definition: The sensitivity of a position's value to a unit change in the underlying price.

terms.name: Gamma
terms.definition: The rate of change of delta with respect to the underlying price.

terms.name: Vega
terms.definition: The sensitivity of value to a change in implied volatility.

terms.name: Theta
terms.definition: The sensitivity of value to the passage of time (time decay).

terms.name: Rho
terms.definition: The sensitivity of value to a change in interest rates.

terms.name: Higher-Order Sensitivity
terms.definition: Higher-order risk sensitivities such as skew, speed, and cross-correlation effects.

terms.name: Counterparty Credit Spread Sensitivity
terms.definition: The sensitivity of value to a one-basis-point move in the counterparty's credit spread (CS01).

terms.name: Own Credit Spread Sensitivity
terms.definition: The sensitivity of value to a one-basis-point move in Wells Fargo's own credit spread.

terms.name: Recovery Rate
terms.definition: The assumed recovery rate on default for counterparty or own credit.

terms.name: Credit Valuation Adjustment
terms.definition: The adjustment to derivative value reflecting counterparty credit risk.

terms.name: Initial Margin
terms.definition: Margin posted to cover potential future exposure on a trade.

terms.name: Collateral Agreement Reference
terms.definition: Reference to the CSA or collateral agreement governing margining.

terms.name: Traded Position
terms.definition: The position quantity on a traded basis as of the business date.

terms.name: Settled Position
terms.definition: The position quantity on a settled basis as of the business date.

terms.name: Position Cost
terms.definition: The cost basis of a held position.

terms.name: Position Identifier
terms.definition: The identifier of a position or inventory holding.

terms.name: Inventory Name
terms.definition: The name of the inventory book holding the position.

terms.name: Counterparty Identifier
terms.definition: The identifier of the counterparty that participates in a financial transaction.

terms.name: Customer Identifier
terms.definition: The identifier of the customer associated with the trade.

terms.name: Customer Name
terms.definition: The name of the customer associated with the trade.

terms.name: Legal Entity
terms.definition: The legal entity of Wells Fargo or the counterparty booking the trade.

terms.name: Desk
terms.definition: The trading desk that owns the trade or position.

terms.name: Portfolio
terms.definition: The portfolio or book to which the trade is assigned.

terms.name: Business Unit
terms.definition: The organisational business unit responsible for the trade.

terms.name: Trader
terms.definition: The trader who executed or owns the trade.

terms.name: Region
terms.definition: The geographic region of the book or desk.

terms.name: Sales Credit Amount
terms.definition: The sales credit attributed to a trade for revenue allocation.

terms.name: Sales Markup
terms.definition: The markup applied on a trade contributing to sales revenue.

terms.name: Marketing Fee
terms.definition: The marketing fee or marketer compensation associated with the trade.

terms.name: Commission
terms.definition: Commission charged or paid on the trade.

terms.name: Settlement Currency
terms.definition: The currency in which the trade settles.

terms.name: Clearing Broker
terms.definition: The broker through which the trade is cleared.

terms.name: Executing Broker
terms.definition: The broker through which the trade was executed.

terms.name: Clearing Account
terms.definition: The GMI or clearing account identifier.

terms.name: TRACE Control Number
terms.definition: The FINRA TRACE control number assigned on regulatory trade reporting.

terms.name: MSRB Code
terms.definition: The MSRB classification applied for municipal securities reporting.

terms.name: Regulatory Trade Identifier
terms.definition: Identifiers assigned by regulatory or venue reporting systems (WINFITS, venue, MIC).

terms.name: Hedge Indicator
terms.definition: Flags identifying bona-fide hedge or DSOM status for regulatory purposes.

terms.name: Trade Date
terms.definition: The date on which the trade was executed.

terms.name: Settlement Date
terms.definition: The date on which the trade settles.

terms.name: Maturity Date
terms.definition: The date on which the instrument matures or expires.

terms.name: Business Date
terms.definition: The processing business date of the record.

terms.name: Execution Timestamp
terms.definition: The precise time the trade was executed or booked.

terms.name: Source File Name
terms.definition: The name of the source file from which the record was ingested by 1MBDA.

terms.name: Source System Identifier
terms.definition: The identifier of the originating source system (SOR).

terms.name: Source Dataset Identifier
terms.definition: The identifier of the source dataset within the SOR.

terms.name: Ingestion Timestamp
terms.definition: The time at which 1MBDA ingested the record.

terms.name: Record Hash
terms.definition: Hash values used for change detection and record integrity.
